Tripweave · UI/UX pass · 10 Nov 2026

The app screens, tightened.

A review of the planner, itinerary, checkout, booking, account and sign-in screens using the newly installed design skills, then the fixes. The landing page kept its layout; it only picked up the new Geist display type.

Type

Geist everywhere, to match the demo video

Instrument Serif is gone. Headlines now use Geist 500 with tight tracking, big totals use Geist 300, and the accent word is carried by ember color instead of italics. This is the “Ember Night” spec from the video session.

Landing hero

/

Itinerary

The trip page tells the truth

Buttons that did nothing now work or are gone, the scroll tabs track the right section, hotels show their own photo, and the page fits a 320px phone.

Hero and top bar

/trip
  • HighThe hero photo’s alt text always described Oahu’s Lanikai Bay, even on a Kyoto trip. It’s now decorative (the title says where you’re going).
  • HighSave and Share were dead buttons. Save now writes to Saved places with a pressed state; Share uses the system share sheet or copies the link and announces it.

Section tabs

/trip · Day by day
  • MediumThe sticky budget card always counted as “in view”, so the Budget tab stayed active. It only drives the tabs once the layout stacks on narrow screens. Active tab is exposed as aria-current.
  • HighThe budget line always said “under your limit”, even when over (it would print a negative amount). It now says “$X over” in ember with a different icon.

Where you’ll sleep

/trip · Stay
  • Medium14 of the 21 catalog hotels borrowed a city or landing photo (a Greek seaside room stood in for a Gion hotel). Each now has its own image, plus 3 activities that showed the wrong place.
  • High“Swap stay” and the “Ask for a change…” box looked live but did nothing. Removed rather than faked.

At 320px

/trip · phone
  • HighThe page was 341px wide on a 320px screen. Top-bar chips collapse to icons (their text stays as the accessible name) and the subnav total hides below 420px.
  • HighOn phones the “Back to chat” link lost its text and became a nameless arrow. The label is now visually hidden but still read out.

Checkout

Paying checks the passport first

The page said “Passport missing. Add it before paying” and then let you pay anyway.

Review and pay

/checkout
  • HighPressing Pay with a missing required document now shows what to add, next to the button, with a link that moves focus to the documents card.
  • HighThe PayPal dialog trapped nothing: focus stayed behind it and Escape did nothing. Focus now moves in, Escape closes, the page behind is inert, and focus returns to Pay.
  • MediumTraveller fields were pre-filled with “Mara Okafor / Daniel Reyes” for everyone. They use the signed-in account, show a second traveller only when there is one, and carry autocomplete tokens.

Account

One number for one plan

The account page priced the current plan from demo data, not the plan the agent actually built.

Current plan

/account
  • HighThe total, dates and traveller count now come from the same trip view as the itinerary and checkout.
  • HighPreference chips showed “on” by color only. They now show a check icon and expose aria-pressed.
  • Medium“Clear recent plans” and “Clear demo receipts” deleted instantly. Both now offer Undo. The receipt download button, which did nothing, saves a text receipt.

At 320px

/account · phone

Planner and sign-in

Fewer dead ends

Planner on a phone

/plan · phone
  • MediumThe sidebar disappears below 860px and nothing replaced it. The mobile bar now links to the account (or sign-in).
  • HighThe closed “Plan” sheet sat off-screen but its links were still reachable by Tab. It’s hidden when closed, takes focus when opened, and closes on Escape.
  • HighAgent replies streamed in silently for screen readers. Each finished reply and question is now announced once through a status region.
  • MediumThe destination heart did nothing. It saves the place with a filled, pressed state. Trip tabs follow the keyboard tab pattern (arrows, Home, End).
  • LowWhile the agent works, the budget reads “Calculating…” (not “Waiting for answers”) and the composer says the planner is working. The live-fares card names the real airports (ITM, not KIX).

New photography

17 images, one film look

Generated with OpenAI gpt-image-2.6-sunburst (picked over the flare variant in a side-by-side) from one shared Portra-film preamble, so they sit with the existing set. 14 hotel rooms and 3 activities, saved as WebP in public/images/dest/.

Left for later

Not changed

Checkout copy still says the agent books each supplier with the payment, while the README and ADR say PayPal pays only for Tripweave’s plan. That’s a product decision, so the wording is untouched. Leaving the planner and coming back still resets the chat. Nothing is committed yet.
